name: What is the process for professional mold removal around a window?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional mold removal around a window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional mold removal involves several key steps. First, the area is contained to prevent spore spread. Next, the moisture source is identified and repaired. Affected materials are then removed or thoroughly cleaned using specialized equipment and EPA-approved antimicrobial agents. Finally, the area is dried completely, and any necessary repairs to walls, sills, or window frames are completed to restore the area and prevent recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes containment, moisture source repair, removal/cleaning of affected materials, drying, and final repairs to prevent mold recurrence.
